meta.title: Multiple Sclerosis | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Managing symptoms and maintaining mobility and daily function.

overview: Multiple sclerosis affects the protective coating of nerves in the brain and spinal cord, producing symptoms ranging from fatigue and weakness to problems with vision, balance and cognition.

At Cambridge Hospital, rehabilitation focuses on managing relapses, preserving mobility, building energy-conservation strategies and supporting emotional well-being. Supervised physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech and swallowing assessment, and psychological support are delivered across inpatient and outpatient settings.
